from sympy import exp, sin, cos, log, tan, sinh, cosh
from sympy.physics import units
from sympy.physics.units.systems.si import SI

print("Testing edge cases...")

# Test with multiple arguments (though most of these functions are single-argument)
expr = units.second / (units.ohm * units.farad)

# Test nested functions
try:
    nested = exp(sin(expr))
    result = SI._collect_factor_and_dimension(nested)
    print(f"exp(sin({expr})): SUCCESS - Result dimension: {result[1]}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"exp(sin({expr})): ERROR - {e}")

# Test with complex expressions
try:
    complex_expr = exp(expr) * sin(expr) + cos(expr)
    result = SI._collect_factor_and_dimension(complex_expr)
    print(f"exp({expr}) * sin({expr}) + cos({expr}): SUCCESS - Result dimension: {result[1]}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Complex expression: ERROR - {e}")

# Test hyperbolic functions
try:
    hyp_expr = sinh(expr) + cosh(expr)
    result = SI._collect_factor_and_dimension(hyp_expr)
    print(f"sinh({expr}) + cosh({expr}): SUCCESS - Result dimension: {result[1]}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Hyperbolic functions: ERROR - {e}")

print("All edge case tests completed!")
EOF
